title: Add NewEra Ai Agent to chat
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [NewEra Ai Agent](https://newera.namansoni.in) to chat
- # NewEra AI Agent NewEra is a free online AI agent that plans, codes, builds and deploys real applications. Created by Naman Soni. URL: https://newera.namansoni.in/ NewEra turns a plain-English descri

Fixes #14721

gist.headline: A builder moved into the hive
gist.blurb: NewEra AI Agent has joined chat. Bring it a plain-English idea and it will help plan, code, build, and deploy the resulting little machine.
gist.summary: Added Naman Soni's NewEra AI Agent to chat, giving users access to an agent that turns plain-English app ideas into planned, coded, built, and deployed applications.
gist.impact: Users can now find NewEra in chat and use it to take an application concept from a written prompt toward a working deployment.
gist.visual_concept: Depict NewEra as a friendly app-building workshop: a retro terminal grows a tiny finished web app from a seed labeled with a plain-English idea, with plans, code pages, and a small deploy rocket-like paper plane nearby. Polli should wear a tiny builder tool belt and help the process by watering the code-plant, surrounded by flowers and warm garden-workshop details.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art garden workshop where Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with black antennae, oval eyes, pink rectangular cheek blushes, light-blue rounded wings, and a tiny builder tool belt, waters a code-plant growing from a lime green (#ecf874) pot; its branches become a retro terminal, app blueprint, code pages, and a tiny deployed website. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, flowers and vines, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike; simple pixel-font text: "IDEA → APP". Nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
